page_title: RMA 0-2 CEL | Real Madrid v Celta Vigo 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' 0 - 2 Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is released by Iago Aspas, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
90+2' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+2' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Rodrygo (Real Madrid) duly receives a yellow card.
90+2' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is shown a red card by the referee after criticising his decision!
90+2' Unsportsmanlike conduct. Endrick (Real Madrid) is shown a red card off the pitch!
90+1' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
88' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Borja Iglesias will be replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
87' Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
87' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
87' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
86' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
86' An attempted cross from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
84' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) replacing Miguel Roman.
83' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
81' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
79' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
79' Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo). Real Madrid earn a free kick.
77' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the left post is comfortably saved by Ionut Radu.
76' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) probably handled the ball. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
74' Here is a change. Arda Guler is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
74' Close! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
73' Referee Alejandro Quintero halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Xabi Alonso, then shows him a yellow.
72' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) for Bryan Zaragoza.
71' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) replaces Oscar Mingueza.
71' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for an infringement.
70' Good movement by Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
69' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.

68' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
67' The attendance for today's match is 74511.
66' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
64' RED CARD! Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Alejandro Quintero. He can have an early bath.
63' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Quintero had an easy-decision to make.
62' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

61' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Thibaut Courtois is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
60' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
59' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.

58' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
57' Referee Alejandro Quintero sees the trip by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Real Madrid have a free kick from a promising distance.
56' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
55' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
54' Substitution. Raul Asencio makes way for Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
53' 0 - 1 Goal! Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) latches onto the ball inside the box and scores a fantastic back-heel goal. He makes it 0:1.
52' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
51' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.

47' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the right side of the goal from a promising distance, but Ionut Radu denies him.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Giraldez gives a chance to Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) and Pablo Duran is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared.

45+3' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

45+2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Ionut Radu shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
45+1' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Real Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
44' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Real Madrid have a corner.
43' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Real Madrid will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
41' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Thibaut Courtois is alert and denies him.
40' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
38' Big chance! A simple pass from Kylian Mbappe left Arda Guler (Real Madrid) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
37' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

34' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Ionut Radu pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
34' Wow, what an escape. Arda Guler (Real Madrid) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
34' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
33' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
29' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) collects a great pass, spins and releases a rocket of a shot from distance. Unluckily for him, it ends well wide of the left post.
26' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
24' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Eder Militao (Real Madrid) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Antonio Rudiger.
24' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
21' The game is interrupted now, Eder Militao (Real Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Quintero stops the game and makes a call.
19' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
17' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

17' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
17' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

16' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom right corner as Ionut Radu produces a good save. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
15' A cross from Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
13' Alejandro Quintero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) and blew his whistle.
12' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
8' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Celta Vigo get a corner.
5' Real Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is able to continue to play.
2' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
